steps: Clicked an empty pixel on sol.college/dapps/picassol-hackathon/ with an injected test wallet: create_pixel
Same click on a local copy of the same build (pixel 33,173): create_pixel
update_pixel → rgb(20,241,149), read back from the account
evidence.functional_evidence: create_pixel landed on devnet from the hosted app. Recolour is script-verified. The points/leaderboard API is a separate backend and does not block painting.
evidence.ui_check: Hosted UI create verified: headless Chromium + injected Wallet Standard wallet on the live sol.college page sent create_pixel from the app's own click handler (tests/devnet/wallet_click.py, log tests/devnet/logs/ui-clicks-2026-11-10.jsonl). Hosted UI recolour (update_pixel via click) is not yet recorded — update_pixel is verified by the program test script only (see Proof).

limitations: Hosted UI recolour not yet recorded. Points/leaderboard need the author's MongoDB backend and its /api/updateUserPoints route, which a static host can't serve (the app's POST gets 501; the pixel tx is unaffected).
